meta.name: Jing Wei Wu Jian
meta.description:
Adapted from the JJWXC novel ‘Jing Wei Qing Shang’ by Qing Jun Mo Xiao/Please Don’t Laugh, this is a romantic story about two incredible young women.  

Legend says that the land was once separated by the Luo river. 

To the south was the agricultural Wei kingdom, and to the north, the nomadic Jing kingdom. 

Agula, a Princess of the Jing kingdom, had to become a Prince since birth so that her loving parents could stay together. Nangong Jingnu, a Princess of the Wei kingdom, was meant to live a carefree life, but the political struggles of the court made it necessary for her to follow the footsteps of her father. 

After a war turned Agula into an orphan, she went into hiding for ten years, honing her skills in order to infiltrate the Wei kingdom as a sycophantic official and bring chaos to the world. However, due to a series of events, she was appointed to be Nangong Jingnu’s husband at the Qionglin banquet…
